app._comment: Static PWA (index.html at repo root, no build step, no root package.json). Served with `python -m http.server 8080` from the repo root; gate.py never starts this itself (checked: nothing in gate.py reads app.start), so the operator running the gate must have that server already up at app.url before running the e2e/a11y_ux domains, or those two will fail closed with connection errors rather than reporting real findings. This local server does NOT apply the repo's `_headers` file (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.) -- those only apply on Cloudflare Pages -- so header-dependent checks here understate what production actually sends. Routes are hash-based SPA routes read from route() in index.html, not guessed: '/' defaults to today's or the latest post; /#/map, /#/ladder, /#/kodex, /#/discover are fixed views; /#/doc/{slug} fetches corpus/{slug}.md (only ai-pr-review and mcp-sensitive-data exist on disk today); /#/2026-07-25 pins a specific day's post and will need updating as the daily post rotates -- it is largely redundant with '/' (same view type) and can be dropped or re-pinned in a later edit without weakening coverage, since '/' already exercises the daily-post view.

unit._waiver_history: WAIVED 2026-07-27 on a WRONG diagnosis, LIFTED 2026-07-29. The waiver claimed the daemon was not running. It was: pid 9784 had held :8788 since 2026-07-22, answering /health 200 and a bare GET 401. The real fault was POST /chat returning 500 from a week-old process whose Claude Agent SDK runtime had gone stale. Restarting it fixed the domain: 10 pass, 0 fail. Two lessons kept here rather than in a commit message. First, 'connection refused' was assumed and never measured; `curl -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8788/health` would have cost nothing. Second, the daemon wrote its stderr nowhere, so the 500 had no trace; it now appends to state/_daemon.log, which is how the restart was confirmed.
unit._comment: Runs the whole tests/ directory as of 2026-07-29; it was pinned to tests/boundaries.test.ts back when that was the only file, which meant a new test file would sit in the repo and never gate anything. Measured 2026-07-29: 22 pass, 0 fail, 35 expect() calls across 2 files. tests/mentor.test.ts is pure logic, hermetic, ~60ms: it lifts the המנטור queue block out of index.html and evaluates it, because the app is one inline script with no module boundary and a hand-copied fixture would drift. It carries a regression oracle for the suppression bug found the same day (a belief is keyed semantically, so suppression must match belief.from, not the belief id; proven to fail against the previous logic before the fix). tests/boundaries.test.ts is NOT hermetic and the gate must not be read as if it were: it makes an authenticated, state-mutating (self-restoring) round trip against the LIVE production Cloudflare Worker at https://sadna-sync.shovalb9.workers.dev, and 4 of its 10 tests require a local daemon answering on http://localhost:8788 (started separately via `cd daemon && bun run server.ts`). If that daemon is not running when the gate executes, those 4 fail closed with connection-refused rather than being skipped. COVERAGE BOUNDARY: this domain is example-based and integration only. There is no property-based, mutation, fuzz or contract testing anywhere in this repo, and the gate has no domain for any of them; filed 2026-07-29 to claude-setup as a gap against work-docs/testing_practices.txt section 6.

types._comment: No tsconfig, .eslintrc, or biome.json anywhere in the repo outside daemon/'s node_modules dependencies, so there is no real typecheck or lint to run -- this is a syntax-only sweep of every piece of JS/shell in the deployed app: sw.js (the only standalone JS file since tree3d.js was deleted on 2026-08-07 as dead code; `node --check tree3d.js` was in this command and failed on node 18 with SyntaxError on `export`, because the file was an ES module and node checks a .js as CommonJS, so the dead file was breaking a required domain), the ~137KB inline <script> block in index.html (the bulk of the app's logic, extracted and checked by the new tools/check_inline_js.py helper added alongside this contract -- see that file for the extraction method), every tools/*.py file via compileall, and the one shell tool script. It catches parse errors, nothing semantic. Personally run 2026-07-25 via the exact shell (subprocess.run(..., shell=True) on Windows, i.e. cmd.exe) that gate.py itself uses: exit 0, 'inline script #0 (113134 bytes): ok' plus clean compileall and bash -n.

e2e._comment: OPERATING INSTRUCTION FOR THIS MACHINE: run gate.py itself via PowerShell here, not the Bash tool / Git Bash. Reproduced 3x: Git Bash/MSYS silently rewrites a bare '/' route argument into a Windows path before flow.py ever sees it (visible in -v output as a mangled '[mobile] C:/Program Files/Git/' route), producing a generic 'websocket closed while reading' failure that is a shell-tooling artifact, not a defect in flow.py, cdp.py, or the app. Switching to PowerShell/cmd.exe (which is what gate.py's own subprocess.run(shell=True) uses on Windows anyway) fixes it. Personally run 2026-07-25 via PowerShell against the live local server: exit 1, 42 fail-level findings (WCAG tap-target and contrast violations down to 1.05:1, and dead controls: #themeToggle and #sndToggle do nothing when pressed on every route audited). This is a real, reproducible app defect, not a harness or contract problem -- confirmed by `flow.py selftest` (26/26 planted defects detected, clean page passes clean). Report written to state/e2e/last.json, schema-verified to match what the a11y_ux domain below reads (by_viewport.mobile[].findings[].{kind,sev,msg}).

waived.reason: RAN FOR THE FIRST TIME ON THIS HOST on 2026-08-08, which is the change that matters: every prior e2e verdict in this repo came from Windows, and under WSL there was no Chrome and no CDP endpoint at all (localhost 9222/9223/9224 and the WSL host IP 192.168.160.1 all returned 000). Unblocked without sudo: @puppeteer/browsers installed Chrome 151.0.7922.77 into ~/.cache/chrome-wsl, and the four libnss/libnspr shared objects it needs were extracted from downloaded debs into a local prefix on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. 8 routes, mobile viewport: 40 fail then 39 fail on an identical re-run, 373 warn. Breakdown of the 40: 17 flow, 20 target, 3 contrast. THE COUNT IS NOT DETERMINISTIC and that is itself evidence for the same defect: #sndToggle's body.innerHTML delta sits right on flow.py's 24-character gate, measured at +27 on one route and +17 on another, so whether it is called dead depends on timing. The confirm string on this waiver was first pinned to (40 fail) and the gate correctly went STALE on the next run at 39, which is the waiver-confirm feature doing exactly its job against my own overprecise number. It now pins #themeToggle instead, because that is the waiver's actual claim: when flow.py stops calling a working toggle dead, this waiver should go stale and be rewritten. 11 OF THE 17 FLOW FAILURES ARE FALSE, AND THIS IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. 7 are #themeToggle and 4 are #sndToggle, and both controls work. Proved by driving the same CDP session with flow.py's own click_js, twice in both directions: pressing #themeToggle flips documentElement.dataset.theme dark<->light and repaints body background-color from rgb(11, 9, 17) to rgb(233, 224, 204) and back, while body.innerHTML.length moves only +10 and +8 and the node count does not move at all. flow.py's STATE_JS (lines 444-454) fingerprints document.body only and never reads document.documentElement or any attribute value, and describe_effect (line 851) calls it a DOM change only above 24 characters. A control whose entire effect is an attribute on <html> is invisible to that fingerprint by construction. flow.py is claude-setup's file, so this lane does not patch it; filed as a cross-lane proposal instead, per the charter. THE 6 REMAINING DEAD CONTROLS ARE NOT COVERED BY THAT PROOF and are real candidates, named so they are not lost inside the 11: the #flat2d tree-tab button, #tab-kodex, a details summary in #view, and a discover-card anchor. Nobody has driven those the way the two toggles were driven. The 20 tap-target and 3 contrast failures are the talent board, whose geometry is frozen: DESIGN.md is binding and the board is the surface behind five rejected design passes. The board rebuild is Phase 1 of the accepted lane C plan, which is why this expires 2026-08-15 rather than later. The aria-pressed fix that PLAN-GATE-TO-GREEN-2026-07-25.md specified WAS applied to both toggles this session and is correct accessibility work, but it does not and cannot clear this oracle, which is worth recording because the expired waiver asserted it would.

a11y_ux._comment: Reads the report the e2e domain just wrote (e2e runs immediately before a11y_ux in gate.py's fixed domain order, so this is always fresh from the same run, not a stale prior report). Filters to accessibility/layout finding kinds only (contrast, target, label, name, text, overflow, image, head, layout) -- dead-control findings (kind=flow) are NOT counted here, only in e2e's exit code, so this domain isolates 'can a phone user perceive and reach the controls' from 'do the controls work'. max_warn 0 is the strict floor recommended by the gate's own starter; given the current backlog (contrast down to 1.05:1, multiple tap targets under the 24x24 WCAG floor including the header wordmark on every route) this domain will legitimately FAIL today. That is an accurate report of the app's current state, not a contract defect.
